themes.name: Bootstrap Icons
themes.author: The Bootstrap Authors; Microsoft (Fluent UI System Icons)
themes.description: Bootstrap's outline icons: crisp, compact 16px glyphs, with Fluent's outlines for the animals Bootstrap doesn't draw.

themes.name: Catppuccin Icons
themes.author: Catppuccin; Luca Burgio (Iconoir); Paweł Kuna (Tabler Icons)
themes.description: Catppuccin's folder and file icons from the Zed extension, with Iconoir's thin round-capped outlines for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Charmed Icons
themes.author: littensy, jmesrje; Microsoft (Fluent UI System Icons); Google (Material Symbols); The Bootstrap Authors
themes.description: littensy's soft filled Charmed Icons for folders and files, with Fluent's filled icons for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: FantastIcons
themes.author: Caio Landgraf; MingCute Design; Microsoft (Fluent UI System Icons)
themes.description: FantastIcons' flat filled folders and files, with MingCute's filled icons for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Fluent Regular
themes.author: Microsoft (Fluent UI System Icons); The Bootstrap Authors
themes.description: Microsoft's Fluent icons in their regular weight: light, rounded outlines in the style of Windows 11.

themes.name: Hugeicons
themes.author: Hugeicons
themes.description: Hugeicons' free stroke-rounded icons: friendly 1.5px outlines with soft corners.

themes.name: IconPark
themes.author: ByteDance
themes.description: ByteDance's IconPark outline icons: chunky, rounded strokes that stay bold at small sizes.

themes.name: JetBrains Icons
themes.author: JetBrains (IntelliJ Platform classic icons); Zeeshan Ahmad; The Bootstrap Authors; Microsoft (Fluent UI System Icons); Google (Material Symbols)
themes.description: JetBrains IntelliJ's classic flat icons wherever the IDE has one, with Bootstrap's filled icons, and a few of Fluent's and Material's, for the rest.

themes.name: JetBrains New UI Icons
themes.author: JetBrains (IntelliJ Platform New UI icons); ankddev; Paweł Kuna (Tabler Icons)
themes.description: The JetBrains IDEs' New UI icons wherever the IDE has one, with Tabler's icons redrawn at the same 1px weight for the rest.

themes.name: Kokedera Icons
themes.author: Florian Mühlhans; Phosphor Icons
themes.description: Kokedera's mossy folders and files, with Phosphor's filled icons, as soft and rounded, for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Lucide
themes.author: Lucide Contributors
themes.description: Kanso's own icons, from Lucide: the look Kanso has without an icon theme.

themes.name: Material Icon Theme
themes.author: Zed Industries; Google (Material Symbols); The Bootstrap Authors
themes.description: The Material Icon Theme's folders and files, with Google's filled Material Symbols for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Material Symbols Outlined
themes.author: Google (Material Symbols); The Bootstrap Authors
themes.description: Google's Material Symbols in their outlined style: clean, even outlines on Material's grid.

themes.name: Min Icons
themes.author: Phillip Bronzel; IBM (Carbon); Paweł Kuna (Tabler Icons)
themes.description: The Min theme's thin, chamfered Chalice icons for folders and files, with IBM's Carbon icons, as thin and square, for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: MingCute Line
themes.author: MingCute Design
themes.description: MingCute's line icons: crisp, rounded outlines with a light, even stroke.

themes.name: Monospace Icons
themes.author: Isheunopa Ralph Mhonde; Google (Material Symbols); The Bootstrap Authors
themes.description: Firebase Studio's Monospace folders and files, with Google's filled, rounded Material Symbols for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Phosphor
themes.author: Phosphor Icons (Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried)
themes.description: Phosphor's regular icons: rounder and a little heavier than Kanso's own, for every icon Kanso draws.

themes.name: Phosphor Bold
themes.author: Phosphor Icons (Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried)
themes.description: Phosphor's bold weight: heavy, rounded strokes that read at a glance.

themes.name: Phosphor Duotone
themes.author: Phosphor Icons (Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried)
themes.description: Phosphor's duotone icons: regular strokes over a soft tinted fill.

themes.name: Phosphor Icons Theme
themes.author: Theo Luciano; Phosphor Icons
themes.description: Phosphor's regular icons with the folders and files Theo Luciano's Zed extension picks.

themes.name: Phosphor Thin
themes.author: Phosphor Icons (Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried)
themes.description: Phosphor's thin weight: hairline strokes for a quiet, airy interface.

themes.name: Serendipity Icons
themes.author: Nguyen Dang Vinh; Paweł Kuna (Tabler Icons)
themes.description: Serendipity's tiny square file and folder icons, with Tabler's icons redrawn thin with square corners for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: Symbols
themes.author: Joan Garcia; Paweł Kuna (Tabler Icons)
themes.description: Miguel Solorio's Symbols for folders and files, with Tabler's matching 2px round-stroked icons for the rest of Kanso.

themes.name: TDesign Icons
themes.author: TDesign (Tencent)
themes.description: Tencent's TDesign icons: clean geometric outlines on a 24px grid.
